chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr, from al-Ḥasan ibn al-Sarī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The sunnah (prophetic tradition) is that you place your two fingers in your ears during the adhan.

key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: the established prophetic tradition or recommended practice

ai.seo_question: Is it sunnah to place the fingers in the ears during the adhan?
ai.summary: This hadith states a recommended sunnah act related to the performance of the adhan. It indicates that placing two fingers in the ears while calling the adhan is part of the prescribed devotional manner in worship.
